gabor_coarse_energy_share.definition: Sum of mean squared complex filter responses at period 64 px / sum across periods 16,32,64 px and four wavevector directions, pooled equally across four fixed windows.

gabor_axial_strength.definition: Absolute energy-weighted mean exp(2j theta) across four wavevector directions, all three periods and four fixed windows. Direction is the modulation wavevector, normal to a stripe.

gabor_horizontal_wavevector_balance.definition: Energy-weighted mean cos(2 theta) across all periods/windows; positive means horizontal wavevectors (vertical stripes), not horizontal graphite plates.

windows.centres: x,y in quarter and three-quarter trimmed frame
windows.aggregation: equal window mean power before energy ratios
windows.invalid_window: any missing/nonfinite/insufficient contrast window abstains entire site

kernel: Complex Gaussian modulated harmonic; fixed square support ±ceil(3sigma); finite-support mean removed, unit complex-L2 norm.
normalisation: Nominal 2x2 area averaging; each window mean-zero/unit-SD, sigma<=1e-6 on 0-1 scale abstains; no percentile thresholds or feature normalisation by batch.
sensitivities: All31 known sites: full resolution, gamma0.75/1.25 and non-clipping affine0.1+0.7x; retained raw periods and same windows.
quality: No phase mask. All-known retains observed acquisition subgroups; matched excludes known low-bright-contrast and grey-pore, unknown flags abstain; ordinary additionally excludes known long-void reference examples without assuming clean material.
controls: Separate alpha1 ridge: acquisition6 versus FFT/geometry/tensor11; whole-site LOO, fold-local median imputation/scaling; within-batch/ordinary-reference correlations. No residual or classifier promoted.
interval: 4000 percentile site-bootstrap draws; seed20261003; site-median differences, deletion ranges; unknown specimen independence.
scope: Already explored known batches only; windows/pixels are coverage, not n; wavevector is normal to stripes, not plate axes.
stop_go: Retain exploratory maps for review; independent expert/spatial repeatability and nuisance/redundancy checks gate material use. No scale or mode chosen by attractive separation; no neural/outcome training or new QC decision driver.
